description: Modeli ladilikan telesarse walasa ka baro daminɛ, walima ka Hub lajɛ walasa ka dɔ wɛrɛ sɔrɔ.
quickStartFailed: Fɛn dɔ ma ɲɛ. Aw ye aw jija ka segin a kan.
exploreHub: Aw ye modɛli wɛrɛw lajɛ Hub kɔnɔ
checkSystemFailed: A ma se ka fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw kunnafoni kalan
checkEngineGpuUnused: {{backend}} ye CPU-dɔrɔn jɔli ye, o la {{gpus}} bɛna sigi baarakɛbali la. GPU kɔkannafɛn dɔ sugandi Settings kɔnɔ walasa ka baara kɛ n’a ye.
checkEngineVendorMismatch: {{backend}} mago bɛ {{vendor}} GPU la, nka Novera sɔrɔla {{gpus}}. Novera bɛna boli CPU kan.
checkEngineRuntimeUnreachable: {{backend}} tɛ se ka se i ka GPU ma, o la Novera bɛna boli CPU kan. A ka c’a la, o kɔrɔ ye ko GPU bolifɛntigi walima boli waati mago bɛ ladamuni na.
checkEngineMissingLibrary: {{backend}} tɛ se ka daminɛ bawo gafemarayɔrɔ wajibiyalen dɔ tɛ yen ({{libraries}}), o la Novera bɛna boli CPU kan.
checkEngineProbeFailed: Se ma se ka a jira ko motɛri bɛ se ka baara kɛ ni i ka GPU ye.
checkEngineUnavailable: Nin motɛri jɔli tɛ se ka GPU cogoya fɔ
checkSearchNoVector: Embedding model ma jaabi foyi lase, o la file ɲinini tɛna baara kɛ fɔlɔ
checkSearchInvalidVector: Embedding model ye jaabi dɔ segin min tɛ se ka baara kɛ, o la filen ɲinini bɛ se ka foyi segin
checkSearchProbeFailed: A ma se ka embedding model sɛgɛsɛgɛ
checkSearchUnavailable: Nin motɛri jɔli in tɛ se ka embedding model sɛgɛsɛgɛ
welcomeTitle: Novera ka kan ka sigi sen kan i ka sistɛmu kan
welcomeBody: O bɛ miniti damadɔ ta : Novera b’a ka inference engine ni modeli fitinin dɔ telesarse dosiye ɲinini kama. I bɛ se ka to ka baara kɛ ni i ka ɔridinatɛri ye k’a sɔrɔ a bɛ baara la.
badgeGpu: A bɛna baara kɛ ni i ka GPU ye.
otherWarnings: {{count}} sɛgɛsɛgɛli wɛrɛw fana mago bɛ jateminɛ na.
setupDoneBody: Novera bɛna sigida modɛliw boli ni llama.cpp ye.
dsparkEnable: Ka DSpark teliya (a bɛ se ka kɛ) .
dsparkDescription: A bɛ DSpark Q8_0 taamaɲɔgɔn ({{size}}) telesarse LFM2.5-2.6B kama. A bɛ se ka sɛnɛ teliya, nka a bɛ baara kɛ ni RAM walima VRAM wɛrɛ ye, ka hakilijagabɔ dɔɔnin to sigida la. A kɔrɔbɔ i ka fɛnɲɛnamafagalanw kan; ka contexte janya ladilan walima ka speculative decoding bali model settings kɔnɔ.
